name: Swift1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: linear attention with full attention every 4th layer (12 of 48)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, not a new base model: same config.json, same 180.0 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-22. Caveats: the card compares at thinking xhigh and only 2 of the 7 scored rows go up; GPQA-Diamond (89.60 vs 89.80), MMLU-Pro, IFBench, AIME 2026, HMMT and ERQA are all LOWER than base. Its headline is token economy (63.4% fewer median thinking tokens), not accuracy. The Terminal-Bench 2.1 row is explicitly flagged by the card as not apples-to-apples: the base ran default task timeouts.
